items.section: Discovery needs a controlled escape hatch
items.text: In cross-compiled DIRECTX9, DIRECTX11, DIRECTX12 and Direct2D trees, CnaTests carries a CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR that runs the Wine wrapper with its engagement gate disabled (CNA_D3D9_SKIP_DXVK_GATE=1, CNA_D3D11_SKIP_DXVK_GATE=1, CNA_D3D12_SKIP_VKD3D_GATE=1). The property applies to discovery and to every discovered case and CnaTests-command route (e.g. CnaInputTests), so a GoogleTest case that creates a device in such a tree is not proven to have run through DXVK or vkd3d-proton.
items.evidence: cmake/UnitTests.cmake (set_target_properties(CnaTests PROPERTIES CROSSCOMPILING_EMULATOR ...) and its comment naming CnaInputTests)

items.section: Proton solves a different reproducibility problem
items.text: The DIRECTX12 Proton lane defaults to the moving "Proton - Experimental" runtime, records no pinned identity, applies no log-token gate and forwards only the child exit status (exec python3 proton run), so a pass through it is not reproducible and does not prove vkd3d-proton served the run; the three DirectX12 Proton fixtures depend on it.

Software_XnaLineCoverage, described by CNA as a permanent exact CTest for the two line scenes, runs run-oracle-corpus-diff-software.sh, which exits non-zero only on a render failure or missing reference; a pixel difference is printed as DIFF and the test still passes.

No workflow runs the XNA oracle corpus: D3D9_XNA_Diff exists only in a DIRECTX9 MinGW tree under Wine+DXVK, Fna3d_XNA_Oracle and the line-coverage CTests are in no workflow configuration except that EasyGL_XnaLineCoverage is reachable from general-tests-ci.yml, which does not install the Pillow module xna-diff.py imports. The DIRECTX9 39/39 record has not been repeated on native Windows.

items.section: Can a green test go red?
items.text: The Direct2D mutation checker is wired only as --dry-run (anchor existence) in the manual-dispatch d3d-windows-ci.yml; the --run mode that rebuilds and requires each targeted test to fail is never automated, so no mutation is known to be killed.
No workflow configures gcov, lcov, gcovr or llvm-cov and no CMake option adds coverage instrumentation; the only line-coverage figure is a hand-recorded 2026-08-18 report for graphics-ext.

The libFuzzer/AFL-capable harnesses (cna_compiled_effect_fuzzer with CNA_FX_FUZZER_ENTRY_POINT, cna_xna_model_fuzzer, cna_xna_intermediate_fuzzer, and the C API StringView/CubeLut fuzz sources) are not CTests and no workflow runs any fuzzing campaign; only deterministic fuzz-named GoogleTests run.
items.evidence: cmake/Harnesses.cmake (fuzzer targets, "Not registered as a ctest"); modules/c-api/tests/fuzz/

items.text: The FNA value-differential harness (tools/fna-reference, cna_reference_dump, compare-fna-reference.py) is a manual workflow: not a CTest and not in CI, and its comparison is one-directional (CNA-only keys are never reported).
Recorded Vulkan, Software and DirectX11 glTF L7 golden sets and the registered WebGPU, SDL_GPU and OpenGL4 parity-fixture CTests are run by no workflow; only the EasyGL/OPENGLES3 L7 job is in CI.

No workflow or configure preset enables CNA_BUILD_INSPECTOR, so the 27 InspectorTests never compile in CI; macOS runtime behaviour is recorded by CNA as pending; the WebBridge has no automated test (see B9 P2-102).
